# A-B test plan

Plan for comparing two versions of the checkout page. We split the visitors in two equal groups, keep one as the control and change a single variable in the other: the label of the button. The trial runs for two full weeks so that weekday effects cancel out.

Success is a measurable gain in completed orders, with a threshold agreed in advance. If the result is inconclusive we do not extend the test; we write down what we learned and design the next trial. Only one variable at a time, otherwise nobody knows which change made the difference.

Results go into the experiment log at the end of each trial.
